segments.text: The relative delta panel disappears after turn-in and the number freezes until the next straight.
This needs to be a ticket.
It begins when the car loads up in the fast right-hander, and the expected live value stops changing.
The driver view still shows the stale number even after steering returns to center.
The display comes back on the following straight, then freezes again under the next heavy load.
Expected behavior is continuous updates through the corner instead of holding the old delta.
The color also flips from green to red while the numeric value remains unchanged.
New ticket: the pit limiter indicator is missing.
That separate request belongs to the pit-lane display and not the delta panel discussion.
Later unrelated narration describes traffic and fuel strategy.
